message:
The other day, I decided it was high time to refresh our family's go-bags. Instead of making it a chore, I turned it into a cozy little gathering. I spread everything out on the kitchen table, and invited the grandkids to help. We sorted through snacks, water bottles, and even had a little fashion show with our emergency blankets. 

As we chatted and laughed, I realized that preparedness doesn’t have to feel heavy; it can be an opportunity to connect and make memories. Plus, it’s nice to know we’re ready for whatever comes our way. Have you ever turned a task into a fun family moment?
